d.ko: A turn-based space mecha mercenary game. You can recruit pilots and captains with varying stories and skills, buy and modify spaceships, mecha, artillery, and fighters, take missions, participate in battles between Galactic Powers, change the situations, and experience different stories.
d.en: A turn-based space mecha mercenary game. You can recruit pilots and captains with varying stories and skills, buy and modify spaceships, mecha, artillery, and fighters, take missions, participate in battles between Galactic Powers, change the situations, and experience different stories.
d.zh: 一款回合制宇宙机甲佣兵团游戏。你将率领佣兵团投入内海战争，招募各有不同故事背景和技能的驾驶员和舰长，购买和改装舰艇、机甲、巨炮和战机，接受多种多样的任务，逐渐扩大实力，参与银河列强之间的交战，改变整个战局，迎来不同的故事路线。
